events.verdict: LATR shows Green (CLE) make contact to Lowry's (TOR) arm that affects his driving shot attempt.
James (CLE) sets the screen on VanVleet (TOR) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
James (CLE) and Siakam (TOR) briefly engage and separate.
[Observable in enhanced video] LATR shows that DeRozan (TOR) is in the lane without actively guarding an opponent for longer than three seconds.
Ibaka (TOR) and Hill (CLE) briefly engage and separate.
Siakam (TOR) legally contests James' (CLE) jump shot attempt.
James (CLE) makes incidental contact with DeRozan (TOR) that does not affect his drive to the basket and pass.
VanVleet (TOR) engages with Hill (CLE) and affects his FOM.
Siakam (TOR) makes marginal contact with James (CLE) that does not affect his SQBR.
James (CLE) trips DeRozan (TOR) and affects his FOM.
VanVleet (TOR) and Love (CLE) briefly engage and separate.
Ibaka (TOR) and Hill (CLE) briefly engage and separate.
Siakam (TOR) makes contact with Love (CLE) that affects his SQBR.
Green (CLE) legally contests DeRozan's (TOR) jump shot attempt.
Lowry (TOR) commits a take foul on James (CLE).
Hill (CLE) commits a take foul on DeRozan (TOR).
Siakam (TOR) and James (CLE) make incidental contact with each other during rebounding.
Siakam (TOR) commits a take foul on James (CLE).

James (CLE) obtains a legal guarding position and jumps vertically contesting DeRozan's (TOR) jump shot attempt. The marginal leg to leg contact is created by DeRozan.
